title: Fireplace fireblocking.
officialText: All spaces between fireplaces and floors and ceilings through which fireplaces pass shall be fireblocked with approved noncombustible material securely fastened in place. The fireblocking of spaces between wood joists, beams or headers shall be to a depth of 1 inch (25 mm) and shall only be placed on strips of metal or metal lath laid across the spaces between combustible material and the chimney.
